The beauty is in the details. ✨

#PropertyForSale #luxuryhomedesign #interiordesign #realestateagentlife

There’s something about Zimbali that makes you slow down.

The trees, the coastline, the privacy and then you come home to iLanga Villa where the outside becomes part of the way you live.

At R5.9 million this three-bedroom villa gives you the kind of space that works whether you’re here every day, escaping to the coast on weekends, or looking for a home that can serve both purposes.

The living areas open completely onto the garden and covered patio, with a built-in braai that makes entertaining feel effortless. All three bedrooms have their own bathrooms, the main bedroom has the privacy of its own ensuite sanctuary, and the double garage keeps everything as convenient as the setting is beautiful.

Then there’s everything beyond your front door Bushbuck Club, walking trails, indigenous forest and the beaches of the Zimbali coastline.

This isn’t about buying another townhouse on the North Coast.

It’s about having your own place inside Zimbali.

And on a birthday, there’s no better reminder that life is meant to be lived beautifully.

R5,900,000 | iLanga Villa | Zimbali Coastal Estate

If you’d like to experience it for yourself DM me and let’s arrange your private viewing.

A brand-new home in one of the North Coast’s most sought-after lifestyle estates with no transfer duty.

This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in The Woods 2 at Elaleni is designed around easy, modern coastal living. The open-plan kitchen, dining and living area opens onto a covered patio and private garden, creating a natural space for everyday living and entertaining.

Upstairs, the main bedroom has its own en-suite, with two additional bedrooms sharing a modern bathroom.
And it’s not just the home. Owners have access to an exceptional estate lifestyle, including forest trails, clubhouse facilities, swimming pools, the Leisure Centre, children’s play areas and padel courts.

For someone looking for a home they can move straight into, enjoy and grow into without the additional cost of transfer duty  this is worth seeing.
